entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: your code, $35 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. What brings you to Replogle Globes today?
I would like to know if I can buy a replacement part for my globe.
I don't see replacement parts in our catalog, so I'm not sure we sell them. The store's owner can confirm if you write to (email hidden) Which globe is it, and what part do you need?
It's a freestanding globe on a wooden base, and I need the metal ring around it that holds the globe onto the wooden base.
Thanks, I understand now. The owner at (email hidden) can tell you if that ring is available. How did you first find Replogle Globes?
Makes sense, you searched for it. What did you see that made you click on our store?
Understood, the part is what matters. Did you check anywhere else for that ring, like another store or the maker?
No. I I thought this was the maker.
Ah, I see. We're a store selling Replogle globes, so the owner can say if parts exist. What made you think we were the maker?
